ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_logsigmoid_delta_regret_pairwise_dif_ratio_normalized
ir.intuition: Shift from margin-based losses to a ratio-based contrast on delta_regret that compares the relative difference between winning and losing log probabilities scaled by the regret difference. This uses a sigmoid link on the relative regret-normalized advantage ratio, aggregates by a weighted normalized sum, and constrains by enforcing positivity and scale invariance via ratios rather than margins. This paradigm avoids direct subtraction margins, introduces a signal contrast that is multiplicative and normalized differently, enhancing novelty and robustness to scale changes in regret.
ir.pseudocode:
regret_diff = abs(delta_regret) + epsilon
adv_ratio = (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) / regret_diff
pos_adv_ratio = relu(adv_ratio)
loss_terms = -logsigmoid(pos_adv_ratio)
weighted_loss = loss_terms * weight
norm = sum(weight)
final_loss = sum(weighted_loss) / norm
ir.code:
def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):
    eps = 1e-8
    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']
    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']
    weight = batch.get('weight', ops.ones_like(lpw))
    delta_regret = batch['delta_regret']

    regret_diff = ops.add(ops.abs(delta_regret), eps)
    adv_ratio = ops.div(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), regret_diff)
    pos_adv_ratio = ops.relu(adv_ratio)
    loss_terms = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(pos_adv_ratio))

    weighted_loss = ops.mul(loss_terms, weight)
    norm = ops.sum(weight) + eps
    loss = ops.div(ops.sum(weighted_loss), norm)

    return loss
